did: The Rust Rounds essay for week 46 kept failing on home because three of its scenes ran off the bottom of the frame. I put a corrected copy of that essay in the mailbox, with the same words and the code laid out in fewer lines, so home can render it without anyone touching the box. Then I fixed how it got through: the Monday routine now measures the best-fit, comparison and deep-dive scenes against the video frame before it puts an essay, and says which scene to shorten. A test draws essays at the limit on the real stage, in home's font, to prove the measurement never says a scene is shorter than it is.

calls.title: An essay scene too tall for the frame is rewritten by the routine, not paged
options: The routine's finish refuses it and the routine shortens its own words
Page a long scene the way the weekly call does
calls.why: The words on those scenes are the routine's own, written to fit one frame, so asking it to shorten them cuts nothing you said; paging is what you chose for the call, where the content is yours.
calls.undo: Drop the fit check from finish and page those scenes in the essay's scene list and stage instead (C574).

calls.title: The comparison table has fixed 30/70 columns
options: Fixed columns, 30% for the point and 70% for your answer
Let the browser size the columns, as before
calls.why: With the browser's automatic widths a note's wrapping can't be measured before the put; fixed columns can.
calls.undo: Remove table-fixed and its column widths from the comparison scene, and measure the table some other way (C575).

left: A long take's transcript can still overflow the answer scene, and no routine can shorten your own words; it needs paging or clamping, filed as #3187.
Home holding an overflow instead of retrying hourly is server#977 (from #975).
The weekly call's own test fixture still imports below the web-surface door, as it did before; it needs moving through the door in a separate change.
Week 46's render on home from r2 was not seen: if it hasn't rendered within an hour or so, its failed log on home says why.
